save_hugging_face_model: save a fairseq2 model state dict and config as a Hugging Face Transformers model to a directory
get_hugging_face_converter: get the HuggingFaceConverter instance for a specified fairseq2 model family name
create_HuggingFaceConfig: create a HuggingFaceConfig dataclass with config data, class name, and model architecture
review_HuggingFaceConverter: review the HuggingFaceConverter abstract base class and its to_hg_config and to_hg_state_dict methods
refactor_HuggingFaceConverter_subclass: refactor a HuggingFaceConverter subclass to implement to_hg_config and to_hg_state_dict for a new model family
